Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic.
You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company.
Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

What collaboration with Elitmind looks like?

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.
Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.
Strong Data & AI expertise

Collaborate with experienced Data & AI experts across different areas, technologies and enterprise projects.
Technology that keeps moving

Work across the Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake ecosystems, with new technologies regularly explored and applied to real business challenges.
Different projects, different challenges

Our projects span different industries, technologies and business contexts, so there's always something new to solve.
Real autonomy

Take ownership of your scope and independently organize how you deliver the agreed outcomes.

Flexibility that works around your life

Choose where you work best and organize your working hours with flexibility. Work remotely or book a desk in our office whenever you want to collaborate or meet the team in person.

Strong practical knowledge of Azure and its data platform ecosystem.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses or Delta Lake solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including modern capabilities such as Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog.

Experience designing architecture covering connectivity, authentication, authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Experience working directly with clients and different technical and business stakeholders.
Very good command of English.

Recruitment process

1. HR conversation

We talk about your experience, motivation and expectations, and give you the context you need to decide whether Elitmind makes sense for you.
2. Skills interview

You'll meet one of our experts and talk about your experience, previous projects and how you approach real problems relevant to the role.

You'll meet the person responsible for the area to talk about projects, expectations and mutual fit.

jobs.title: Distributed Systems Engineer 4/5 - Cloud Platform Infrastructure Engineering Tooling
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix has been changing how people watch shows and movies, enabling on-demand access to thousands of movies and TV shows. Recently, Netflix has expanded its entertainment offering to include Live content, like the Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson match, the NFL Christmas Games, Beyonce's halftime show, the SAG Awards ceremony, and more. Bringing stories in real time to 300+ million viewers around the world is a hard challenge, demanding exceptional levels of scaling, reliability, stability, and operational excellence across our Cloud Platform stack.

About The Team

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (CIE) builds and operates the foundational platform that Netflix runs on — compute, storage, networking, and performance infrastructure, at global scale. We think of ourselves as platform engineers for infrastructure: building the systems, tools, and abstractions that let Netflix's engineering organization move fast without compromising reliability or efficiency.

We are building the Cloud Infrastructure Tooling team in Warsaw — a new team that will sit at the center of CIE, acting as a multiplier across compute, storage, networking, and performance teams.
The charter is to build internal tooling, developer-facing UIs, and shared services that reduce duplication and let CIE's domain teams to increase velocity. The problems we'll solve are technically challenging: our customers will be some of the most demanding infrastructure engineers in the industry, and the systems they depend on run at Netflix scale.

If you want to understand the kind of engineering this team supports, explore:

Auto Scaling Production Services on Titus
Noisy Neighbor Detection with eBPF
Region Evacuation Reimagined
Evolving Region Evacuation
Consistent caching mechanism in Titus Gateway
Mount Mayhem at Netflix: Scaling Containers on Modern CPUs

What You Will Do

Design, build, and operate software solutions and tooling that serve CIE's compute, storage, networking, and performance engineering teams — the engineers who run Netflix's cloud infrastructure.
Solving real business needs at a large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills.
Building software solutions and tools to improve developer experience and product experience in collaboration with team members and stakeholders.
Architecting and building a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.
Responsible for driving alignment with stakeholders and setting partner expectations.
Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and TPM across teams.
Sharing our experiences with the open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS.

What We Are Looking For

7 or more years of experience designing and building complex, scalable distributed data infrastructure
Proficiency in at least one of: Java, Go, or C++, with a strong software engineering foundation that enables you to write clean, maintainable, high-performance code.
Practical understanding of at least one infrastructure domain — compute, distributed storage, or cloud networking or performance.
Experience owning and delivering high-impact systems end-to-end, with accountability in dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environments.
Experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

What Sets You Apart

Motivation to work on infrastructure that other engineers depend on, with a focus on building systems that are reliable and resilient.
Bringing a product mindset to internal tooling: you think about developer experience, adoption, and the real-world impact on the teams you serve.
Comfort with ambiguity and experience helping to shape problem definitions as well as solutions
Experience contributing to or engaging with open source infrastructure communities.
You approach technical challenges from first principles — you don't reach for familiar patterns when a better solution exists.

Want to know more about how we work at Netflix? You can read more about Netflix culture.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Du utvecklar lösningar som hjälper människor att förstå sin energianvändning, hantera sina abonnemang, följa sina fakturor, beställa tjänster, få information om driftstörningar och bidra till energiomställningen. Våra system hanterar stora mängder data från mätare, energisystem, kundplattformar och IoT-lösningar, där tillgänglighet, skalbarhet och säkerhet är avgörande.

Rollbeskrivning

I rollen som Systemutvecklare blir du en viktig del av vår satsning inom digital produktutveckling. Du kommer att arbeta med utveckling och vidareutveckling av våra digitala produkter och tjänster, med särskilt fokus på moderna backendlösningar och integrationer. Rollen i korthet:

• Arbeta med moderna Azure-baserade lösningar och molntjänster
• Bidra till utveckling av CI/CD-flöden, automatisering och Infrastructure as Code

Rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta brett inom vår Azure-miljö, där vi använder tekniker och tjänster såsom Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps och CI/CD-flöden. Här får du bygga API:er, integrationer och händelsebaserade lösningar i en modern molnplattform där både applikationer och infrastruktur hanteras som kod. AI är en naturlig del av vår utvecklingsprocess. Vi använder AI-assistenter och agenter för att öka produktiviteten, förbättra kvaliteten och automatisera repetitiva uppgifter, samtidigt som vi ställer höga krav på säkerhet, integritet och kontroll.

Din profil och bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för systemutveckling och som drivs av att skapa lösningar som ger verkligt värde. Du är nyfiken och öppen, både när det kommer till ny teknik, nya idéer och i samarbetet med andra människor. Vi ser också att du är ansvarstagande, har ett gott självledarskap och trivs i en miljö där du får ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Vi värdesätter en pragmatisk inställning och förmågan att bidra till ett positivt och prestigelöst teamklimat.

Vi söker dig som:
• Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller har tillägnat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet
• Har erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C# / .NET i en agil utvecklingsmiljö och trivs med molnbaserade lösningar
• Tycker om att bygga robusta API:er och tjänster och ser värdet av testning, automatisering och DevOps
• Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande för rollen är arbetslivserfarenhet inom någon eller flera av Azure-plattformens tjänster. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av distribuerade system, integrationslösningar, eventdriven arkitektur, IoT, tidsseriedata eller energibranschen. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller har flera års erfarenhet är det viktigaste för oss din nyfikenhet, motivation och vilja att sätta dig in i vår verksamhet och utvecklas tillsammans med oss!

Vårt erbjudande till dig

Hos oss blir du en del av en organisation med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag, där digitalisering och teknik spelar en avgörande roll för att skapa hållbara och samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster. Du är med och hjälper människor att använda energi smartare vilket spelar en viktig roll i den pågående energiomställningen.

Här får du:
• Arbeta med moderna tekniker och plattformar i en Azure-miljö där vi kontinuerligt utvecklar våra arbetssätt och lösningar
• Utvecklas tillsammans med positiva och engagerade kollegor i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och starkt teknikintresse
• Bygga specialistkompetens inom en bransch i förändring, där digitalisering är en viktig möjliggörare för framtidens energisystem

Låter det här intressant?

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Experis. Vid frågor är du välkommen att ta kontakt med våra rekryteringskonsulter Jenny Lilja på jenny.lilja@se.experis.com eller Anki Snis på anki.snis@se.experis.com.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och rekommenderar dig därför att visa ditt intresse så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag är 28/10. Tjänsten är placerad på Tekniska verkens huvudkontor i Linköping.

Vi ser fram emot att veta mer om dig!

Tekniska verken

Tekniska verken är en samhällsbärande aktör som varje dag möjliggör ett fungerande och hållbart liv för invånarna i regionen. Genom att säkra allt från energi och vatten till återvinning och digital infrastruktur skapar vi trygghet, livskvalitet och samhällsviktiga tjänster till hundratusentals invånare och företag i regionen – varje dag. As part of our backend teams, you will work with one of Walley's most business-critical products that handles thousands of transactions every day. We follow a DevOps mindset, taking full ownership from idea to production, and continuously improving performance, reliability, and scalability.

You will work in a cross-functional, autonomous team that values quality, collaboration, and learning. Every line of code you write can have a real impact, both on our customers and our business.

5+ years of backend experience, primarily in .NET and C#

Azure Service Bus, CosmosDB, Elasticsearch
Kibana, Grafana
Kubernetes, ArgoCD
Akka

Work with modern technology in a high-impact product area
Be part of a humble and skilled team that values collaboration and learning
Have autonomy and influence over tools, methods, and processes
Help shape the quality culture of one of the Nordics’ leading payment solutions
Ready to build and ensure the quality of the next generation of payment experiences?

Join us at Walley, where great technology meets real-world impact.

We're a tech-driven, autonomous part of the Norion Bank group and have been working with payment solutions and digital purchase journeys since 2005. Walley's product organization is divided into seven autonomous product teams. The product you'll help build is used by millions of customers!

NORION BANK’S OFFER TO YOU

At Norion Bank, we believe that every individual's growth and development should be highly valued. This means a strong focus on self-leadership and continuous competence development. A sense of community, innovation, and modern ways of working are key characteristics of Norion Bank Group. BIAS-FREE RECRUITMENT

INTERESTED?

Great! We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait - apply today! Have any questions? You're very welcome to get in touch with us! For questions about the team or the role, please contact Elsa Karlsson at elsa.karlsson@walley.se.

You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.

Who are you?

We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in both English and Swedish.

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams
Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles
Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments
Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)
Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape
Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

Om företaget

Vår kund är ett internationellt teknikbolag med verksamhet och utveckling i Lund. Här utvecklas mjukvarulösningar inom bland annat fastighetsautomation, där data från olika system i byggnader samlas in, bearbetas och används för att ge bättre förståelse för byggnaders status och behov.

Verksamheten befinner sig i en expansiv fas där utvecklingsteamen får större ansvar och fler initiativ att arbeta med. Det innebär att man nu vill förstärka organisationen med flera nya utvecklare inom olika tekniska områden.

Det handlar om dataintensiva lösningar där stora mängder information behöver hanteras, struktureras och göras tillgänglig för andra delar av systemet och de webbapplikationer som användarna arbetar i.

Ditt arbete ligger framför allt i backend och kan omfatta olika delar av detta flöde - från lösningar nära de enheter som skickar data till de molnbaserade tjänster som tar emot och bearbetar informationen. Du arbetar med att vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar och funktionalitet, med C#/.NET eller Go som möjliga tekniska inriktningar. Azure är en del av teknikmiljön och du kommer även i kontakt med bland annat SQL och databaser.

Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team där utvecklare arbetar nära bland annat QA, DevOps och produktägare. Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för utveckling och som tycker om att lösa tekniska problem tillsammans med andra. Du tar ansvar för det du arbetar med, driver ditt arbete framåt och är samtidigt bekväm med att involvera kollegor när det behövs.

Du kan därför vara relativt tidigt i din karriär och ha byggt upp starka kunskaper genom exempelvis egna projekt eller studier, ha arbetat några år som utvecklare eller ha en längre erfarenhet inom området.

Praktisk erfarenhet av backendutveckling
Erfarenhet av C#/.NET och/eller Go
God förståelse för modern mjukvaruutveckling
God kommunikativ förmåga på engelska

Azure eller andra molnmiljöer
SQL, databaser och arbete med större datamängder
Testautomation och automatiserade tester
CI/CD, DevOps eller andra delar av leveransflödet
Funktionell programmering

Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och samarbetsorienterad. Du uppskattar att sätta dig in i nya tekniska problem och trivs i en miljö där man delar kunskap, hjälper varandra och tillsammans tar ansvar för att hitta bra lösningar.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Inriver is the AI-powered Product Information Management (PIM) platform that helps brands, manufacturers, and retailers turn product data into a growth engine. Inriver connects seamlessly to upstream systems and downstream channels, enabling continuous optimization of product experiences across every touchpoint, and is trusted by more than 1,600 global brands. Our customers — from B2B manufacturers to global retailers — rely on Inriver to manage massive, complex product catalogs and get them to market faster, with less manual rework.

About the role:

We are now looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
to join our team in Malmo to lead technical engagements with our most strategic and complex customers. This is a role for someone who can walk into ambiguous, high-pressure enterprise environments and design the right solution — not just execute someone else's plan. This is a new role within our Engineering team, and we’re looking to hire two Senior Forward Deployed Engineers in Malmö and two in the US.

What you’ll do 💭

Own the technical architecture and delivery strategy for our largest and most complex customer engagements, from discovery through go-live and expansion
Act as the senior technical advisor to customer engineering and IT leadership — often CTOs, VPs of Digital, or Heads of Data — on how Inriver fits into their broader systems landscape
Design and build complex, high-leverage integrations and workflows on top of Inriver's platform, connecting it to ERP/PLM systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics), DAM, and downstream commerce/syndication channels
Model elastic, enterprise-scale product data structures (categories, attributes, relationships, localization) for customers with significant catalogue complexity or regulatory requirements
Lead rapid prototyping efforts to de-risk onboarding, migrations, and pilots for customers with the highest data volume or complexity
Write production-quality code - platform enhancements, connectors, extensions, internal tools — while also knowing when to bring in additional engineering support and how to scope that work
Mentor and technically guide other Forward Deployed Engineers, reviewing their solution designs and unblocking them on hard problems
Serve as a senior technical voice of the customer internally, shaping product and platform roadmap decisions based on patterns across strategic accounts
Own escalated production issues, leading real-time debugging efforts alongside customer engineering teams
Travel to customer sites as needed (expect :20–40% travel depending on account load)

What you’ll bring

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

✔️7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical/customer-facing role, including experience owning complex technical engagements

✔️Strong hands-on coding skills in C#, with the judgment to know when to build vs. when to advise

✔️Extensive experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and enterprise integration patterns (ETL, middleware, iPaaS) at scale

✔️Track record of leading technical relationships with enterprise customers — comfortable being the senior voice in the room with customer executives

✔️Strong ability to reason about complex data models — attributes, taxonomies, relationships — and how they map to messy, real-world enterprise catalogues

✔️Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers, even without formal management responsibility

✔️A bias toward action balanced with the judgment to architect for scale and maintainability, not just the immediate fix

✔️Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate fluidly between deep technical detail and executive-level strategy

✔️Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern deployment practices at enterprise scale

✔️High comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to messy, high-stakes customer environments

Nice to have:

Prior experience with a PIM, MDM, DAM, or product data platform
Deep experience integrating with ERP or PLM systems
Experience with ecommerce/marketplace syndication at scale
Familiarity with compliance-heavy product domains
Prior experience in a senior forward-deployed, solutions architecture, or professional services leadership role at an enterprise SaaS company
Experience contributing to pre-sales or solutioning for large enterprise deals

Why Inriver 💙

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the centre - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. For this role you will also have ownership of the most technically and strategically important customer relationships in the company, direct line of influence into product and platform roadmap decisions and a seat at the table with both customer executives and product leadership.

In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like:

Tuesday Fika☕
Friday breakfasts to start the day together
A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join
A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way

We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline.

Ready to apply? 📬

We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!

Inriver is a global leader in Product Information Management (PIM), helping more than 1,600 brands create outstanding product experiences. Behind our success is a team of talented, collaborative, and passionate people who enjoy solving complex challenges and making an impact for customers around the world.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, we have colleagues across multiple locations globally, bringing together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experiences. For more information, visit www.inriver.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Description

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation). We work with space technology, launch services and systems used by customers around the world.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you want to work with software used in rocket and balloon operations? Are you comfortable with technical systems, troubleshooting and close cooperation with operations and IT?

We are looking for a Software Engineer for our Rockets and Balloons department at Esrange Space Center. The role is practical, technical and closely connected to our launch operations.

As Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain and improve software and operational systems used before, during and after rocket and balloon campaigns.

Requirements

We believe you have solid software development experience, work in a structured way and can cooperate with different technical functions.

Additional desired skills include Swedish language skills, experience with C, C++, .NET, C# or Rust, agile methods, test automation, project coordination, a university degree at bachelor level or higher, and leadership experience.

Fluency in English.
Software development and system administration skills.
Experience from Linux and Windows environments.
Deep experience in at least one programming language.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary technical environments.
Structured problem-solving skills and strong communication skills.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with software and systems that support safe and efficient rocket and balloon operations.

Design, develop, maintain and improve software systems used for launch operations, mission support and campaign execution.
Manage software configurations, releases, documentation and lifecycle activities.
Support troubleshooting, testing, verification and validation of operational software and related systems.
Participate in procurement, development and implementation projects involving software, automation and operational systems.
Ensure software solutions comply with applicable security, safety and quality requirements.
Collaborate closely with IT and other technical teams across SSC Space.

Benefits

We offer you

A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna.

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com

If you are interested in the role, please apply as soon as possible. We review applications continuously and may conduct interviews during the application period.

You can submit your application up until 2026-10-18, which is the latest possible date for consideration. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

With local presence on all continents and about 750 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

Laserfiche is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to drive the modernization of legacy Microsoft-based systems while architecting and operating scalable, resilient AWS-native cloud infrastructure. This role leads the design and implementation of next-generation platforms, leveraging deep expertise in cloud engineering, distributed systems, and modern software development practices.

As a key innovator within the engineering organization, the Principal Software Engineer embeds artificial intelligence—particularly large language models (LLMs)—into both development workflows and product capabilities, accelerating delivery, enhancing developer productivity, and enabling intelligent, data-driven features.

This position requires a hands-on leader who has successfully migrated complex systems to the cloud, possesses strong expertise in AWS services and architecture, and actively applies AI/ML technologies to solve real-world engineering challenges. The ideal candidate thrives in forward-leaning environments, shaping technical strategy while mentoring teams and setting engineering excellence standards across the organization.

Platform Modernization

Re-architect legacy applications into cloud-native services
Move from tightly coupled systems to modular, scalable architecture

Build infrastructure using: Terraform or CloudFormation
Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies using: TFS and AzureDevOps

Code generation and refactoring
Test generation
API design and documentation

Document ingestion and semantic search (RAG)
Workflow automation powered by LLMs
Agentic systems that take actions across services

Structured data, unstructured content, AI reasoning, deterministic workflows

Content & Workflow Systems

Build workflow-driven pipelines (approval, routing, automation)
Enhance workflows using:
AI classification
Summarization
Decision support

Bachelor’s Degree

Experience migrating from Windows to Linux Environments
Experience decomposing monolithic applications into cloud architecture

Strong background in:
C# / .NET (including modernization to .NET Core/.NET 6+)

Deep experience with AWS services (not just exposure)
Experience building and running production systems
Strong understanding of observability, scaling, resilience
Actively use AI tools in your development workflow

Embeddings and vector search
Prompt design and system orchestration

Agentic workflows or multi-step AI pipelines

Able to make pragmatic tradeoffs in:
Migration strategies
Build vs buy decisions

Legacy systems
Modern cloud platforms
Emerging AI tooling

With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

Responsibilities

Position Purpose:
You’ll own automated quality across the Risk & AI Vertical. This is a hands-on, code-writing role: you’ll build and maintain the test automation that keeps our risk modeling, custom data & risk feeds, and interactive visualization products reliable release after release.

You’ll write C# automation to test APIs, services and data pipelines behind risk modeling and the data & risk feeds, and use Playwright to automate the interactive risk-modeling and visualization interfaces across web (and mobile). You’ll embed quality into the agile process, work across the Intelligent Risk and Intelligence Weaving teams, and lean on AI tooling to accelerate test creation and coverage — bringing the same AI-augmented way of working as the rest of the vertical.

Technical Ecosystem

Test Automation: C# automation frameworks (e.g. xUnit / NUnit, NBomber); Playwright for UI / end-to-end (web + mobile web)
API & Service Testing: REST, streaming and gRPC; contract and integration tests
Languages: C# (.NET); TypeScript / JavaScript where useful for Playwright
CI/CD: GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions; automated test pipelines
Under Test: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL; Kafka / ActiveMQ; AI risk models & data feeds; React visualization UIs
Cloud & Infra: Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
Tooling: GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio / Rider
AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, MS Copilot, Anthropic Claude (incl. Claude Code), ChatGPT; AI-assisted test generation and development

Primary Duties Will Include

Design, write and maintain automated tests in C# across APIs, services and data pipelines for risk modelling and the custom data & risk feeds.
Build end-to-end and UI automation with Playwright for the interactive risk-modelling and data & risk-visualization interfaces (web + mobile).
Create and own test frameworks, reusable libraries and test data, and integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines so they run automatically on every change.
Validate data quality, entitlement / permissioning and personalization across the vertical’s products.
Use AI tooling to accelerate test creation, coverage analysis and maintenance.
Partner with engineers across the Intelligent Risk and Intelligence Weaving teams to embed quality early (shift-left), define acceptance criteria, and review coverage.
Triage failures, log defects with clear reproduction steps, and help drive root-cause analysis.
Contribute to regression, performance and reliability testing across web, mobile and APIs.
Participate in code reviews, design sessions and agile ceremonies.

Qualifications

To Land this role you will need

Solid test automation experience with strong C# coding skills — this is a hands-on role that writes real code, not just scripts.
Hands-on experience with Playwright (or comparable modern UI / E2E frameworks such as Cypress or Selenium) for web automation.
Experience automating API / service tests (REST, and ideally streaming or gRPC) and integration tests.
Comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and building and owning test frameworks.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar).
Good working knowledge of databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL) for data validation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sharp eye for edge cases.
Strong collaboration and communication skills; fluent in English (spoken and written).
A growth mindset and a real interest in AI-assisted testing and development.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience testing financial, trading, risk or data-heavy products — or a strong desire to learn.
Experience testing data pipelines, real-time / streaming data, or charting / visualization UIs.
Experience with performance / load testing (e.g. NBomber, k6) and observability (e.g. Grafana).
Mobile test automation experience.
Experience with BDD or contract testing (SpecFlow / Reqnroll, Pact).
Exposure to AI-assisted testing and coding tools (GitHub Copilot, MS Copilot, Anthropic Claude / Claude Code, Cursor).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

Working environment

4 days in office per week

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you a versatile software engineer curious about what happens under the hood of modern software solutions and architectures?

Vuono Group is looking for Software Engineers to join our growing team in Helsinki. We're a process AI company, helping Nordic organisations across the private and public sector create superior business processes and measurable impact through data and AI.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer at Vuono Group, you're comfortable moving across the full stack. Depending on the client project, that means frontend interfaces, backend systems, integrations, cloud platforms, and the automation and CI/CD pipelines that tie it all together.

You care about good software engineering practices and lean ways of working, and you bring that mindset to every client you work with. You act as a trusted advisor, listening, asking the right questions, and building the trust and solutions that solve critical business problems.

We're a tech agnostic and humble team with endless curiosity about what actually works. That curiosity is exactly what we bring to AI too. We're looking for colleagues who are eager to work with AI, but who also aim to understand what's under the surface.

What matters most is your motivation to work at the crossroads of business, technology, and processes, and your drive to solve complex business problems across a variety of industries.

Here's What Helps You Hit The Ground Running

Solid programming skills. We pick whatever tool fits the problem best, but you'll thrive here if you know one or more of: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Java, Clojure, Scala, Swift, Kotlin, React Native, C#, F#, .NET
Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
A decent grasp of how software actually runs - Docker, Terraform, VMs, automation & CI/CD frameworks
Experience with modern API architectures and integration platforms is considered a plus
Interest in AI engineering — integrating frontier APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) or enterprise cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), and automating work with AI assistants and agents (and knowing when off-the-shelf beats building it yourself)
Fluent spoken and written Finnish and English skills
Comfort working with clients and other stakeholders
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
We work closely with our clients, often on-site, so we're looking for candidates who live in, or are planning to move to, the Greater Helsinki area.

Last but not least, you're a kind colleague who thrives in a team that runs on trust, not titles. Things move fast, and being part of a growing consultancy means real room to make your mark and shape where we're headed. If you're driven by business impact and hungry to keep learning, you'll fit right in.

What We Offer

We are building the best work environment for software, data, AI and business processes professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. We’re fostering a high-autonomy environment where collaboration, impact, and everyone’s unique thoughts and ideas are valued.

In addition to the usual perks, such as work tools of your choice and extensive healthcare benefits and insurance, we also offer our employees the opportunity to invest in our rapidly growing company via an employee share program.

We'll discuss the specific responsibilities and focus areas of the role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, the monthly base salary is approximately 5000-7000€+.

Work with leading Nordic companies

At Vuono Group, you’ll collaborate with Nordic clients on a range of challenging digital projects. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, architecture, and how solutions are built. Explore some of our client cases here.

Next steps

If this sounds like your kind of thing, send us your CV or LinkedIn. We'd love to hear from you!

Our recruitment process typically includes at least two interviews, giving you the chance to meet some of our team members and giving us the opportunity to get to know you better: as a professional, a colleague, and a person.

Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Technology — VAT (Wolt & Deliveroo Tax Platform & Business Projects)
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead tax platform projects for Wolt and Deliveroo within our growing Tax Team. As Wolt and Deliveroo onboard onto the global unified tax platform and a single tax calculation engine (Vertex), this role owns the functional tax leadership that turns business and VAT requirements into configured, tested, live capabilities, and leads the offshore Wolt & Deliveroo implementation team delivering that work day to day. As DoorDash continues to grow its international footprint, we are looking for a candidate with deep, hands-on experience in VAT regimes who can lead a team, collaborate cross-functionally, and own the delivery of tax features and new-platform feature / new-market / new-partnership launches across Wolt and Deliveroo.

About The Role

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead tax platform and business projects for Wolt and Deliveroo. You will manage a team to deliver day-to-day VAT configuration and testing, and partner closely with Tax Engineering, the Wolt and Deliveroo Tax teams, Tax Product, and other stakeholders — gathering business and VAT requirements, translating them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration and testing, and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) to provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

The primary focus of this position is end-to-end delivery of VAT tax solutions across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms — new product, market, partnership launches and legislative changes, roadmap alignment with Wolt and Deliveroo's international expansion, and day-to-day leadership of the team executing that delivery — with an understanding of how data flows from upstream systems through the tax engine to downstream reporting. Rather than handing off requirements to the Vertex Center of Excellence team, you will apply your own Vertex knowledge to help influence the functional design and determine the specific Vertex configuration a solution requires. Familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context is valuable for alignment with the broader platform.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead tax platform and business projects across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms, including new product, market, partnership launches, and legislative changes.
Gather business and VAT requirements and translate them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration, testing and delivery.
Review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for VAT tax-system implications and provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.
Define testing requirements and oversee validations across unit, integration, E2E, shadow, and post-launch phases.
Align tax engine priorities and the integrated delivery plan with the Wolt and Deliveroo international market roadmaps, and represent tax platform status updates to Tax and Engineering leadership.
Trace VAT-relevant data from upstream systems through Vertex to downstream reporting and compliance.
Serve as the senior functional tax leader for Wolt and Deliveroo, escalating risk and driving cross-functional alignment across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data.
Manage and develop a team supporting this area, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes.

We’re excited about you because…

You have 8+ years of indirect tax or indirect tax technology experience, with several years working directly in VAT regimes.
You are familiar with VAT tax requirements and can translate them into system requirements.
Hands-on experience implementing or configuring Vertex O Series, and ability to review Vertex configurations and testing documentation and provide feedback.
Hand-on experience implementing or configuring ERP tax integration (e.g. Netsuite) with Vertex tax engine.
Experience with multi-country VAT implementations and EU VAT compliance; familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes more broadly is a plus.
Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including managing, coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight.
You can review technical design documents and provide functional tax expertise to engineering and product.
You have familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context.
You understand how tax data flows from upstream transaction systems through a tax engine to downstream reporting, including both in-house systems or ERP system integration flows.
Program or project management experience across dependent teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Comfort operating cross-functionally and building trust with partner teams without always holding formal authority over their roadmaps.
Experience in use of SQL or Snowflake for data self-serve, issue investigation or testing validation.
Experience in use of API testing tools like Postman, SOAP UI and ability to read XML and JSON logs.
Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or Computer Science degree.
You are fluent in leveraging multiple AI tools on the market (e.g., Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) on a daily basis across all of your assigned tasks, and you actively look for creative ways to apply them to enhance processes and create efficiency gains.

Nice to Haves

Familiarity with Marketplace Facilitator laws.
Experience managing offshore teams across time zones.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine Arbejdsopgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være

Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP
Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter
Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code
Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger
Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger
Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger
Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det Er En Fordel, Hvis Du Har Erfaring Med

Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer
Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Do you feel like the tools that make a game are more interesting than the game itself?

As our new Senior Unity Tools Developer, you’ll join our Core Tech team building and maintaining the shared tools and packages that power everything we make, from hands and cars to horses and beyond.

Your focus will be on making great internal tools: creating solid, well-documented packages, improving our testing and automation setup, and jumping in when Unity issues need debugging.

Here’s what your job looks like day to day

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)
Helping debug and troubleshoot issues in Unity (editor and runtime)
Collaborating with other team members on new packages
Improving the overall game development experience for everyone through better workflows, reliability, and clarity in our shared tools

Must-haves

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization
Strong fundamentals in software design (e.g. unit testing, integration testing, dependency injection, design patterns)
A deep interest in tools development: you get more excited about building tooling and setting up efficient workflows than working directly on player-facing game features
An investigative mindset: you’re curious, thorough, and enjoy getting to the bottom of tricky problems
A genuine interest in sharing knowledge: you enjoy bringing people together, explaining how things work and helping them adopt tools

Nice-to-haves

Experience with automated testing of Unity projects, including on-device testing
Experience with graphics and shaders programming
Interest in experimenting with and using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.
You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.
You value a positive work environment and contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place.
You have team production experiences, such as using version control software (we use git), branching, stand-ups, sprints, and reviews.

Practicalities

We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
No crunch. People over deadlines.
Our working language is English.

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
Pension plan and private health insurance.
Endless amounts of coffee.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Job Title: Principal Data Platform Engineer

Department: Data Marketplace and Platform Engineering, Enterprise IT & Quality.

Location: Ballerup

Your impact begins here

As Principal Data Platform Engineer, you will set the technical direction for the Novo Nordisk DataCore Platform, the enterprise data and analytics platform built on Databricks. You will shape engineering standards, guide architecture and strengthen how scalable, secure and compliant platform capabilities are built. Your work will enable critical business and scientific use cases across the organisation, helping teams deliver progress that reaches people living with serious chronic diseases.

What You'll Bring

To move quickly in this role, you can assess your fit against the following:

A Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field.
Extensive experience in enterprise platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.
Proven expertise with Terraform, AWS, Azure, Databricks, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
A strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and platform automation.
Experience in highly regulated environments such as pharmaceutical, healthcare or financial services.
A strong grasp of governance, security, compliance and operational excellence.
Experience with Data Mesh concepts and enterprise-scale data platforms.
A track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Useful, But Not Essential

Experience working in global enterprise organisations.
Familiarity with enterprise data and analytics platforms.
Experience driving platform modernisation and engineering transformation initiatives.
Knowledge of platform observability, reliability engineering and cloud governance frameworks.

What You'll Do

You will act as a technical authority for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure within the DataCore Platform, combining strategic thinking with deep hands-on expertise. Novo Nordisk DataCore Platform (built on Databricks) – instead of Data Core Platform.

Drive technical leadership and platform engineering strategy for the DataCore Platform.
Define and implement engineering standards, reusable patterns and platform best practices, including Infrastructure as Code and automation.
Lead architecture decisions across NovoNordisk DataCore Platform team, AWS, Azure, Terraform and Databricks, ensuring secure, scalable, reliable and compliant solutions.
Support and enable Data Mesh aligned platform capabilities.
Mentor senior engineers and strengthen engineering excellence across global teams.
Influence platform evolution and technical decision-making across global stakeholders, while ensuring compliance with our quality management system.

Who You'll Work With

You will join the DataCore Platform team within Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo Nordisk value chain to deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working. You will collaborate closely with global engineering teams, and partner with security, governance and enterprise architecture teams to guide platform direction.

Working across organisational boundaries, you will bring perspectives together, create clarity on priorities and help teams move at pace, so the platform keeps delivering value for the business and scientific use cases that depend on it.

For further information, please contact [insert hiring manager name and contact details].

What You Can Expect Here

You will work in a complex, global enterprise environment where your technical expertise shapes decisions well beyond your own team. The role offers the space to build new skills through cross value chain experiences, mentor others and grow alongside colleagues who raise the bar every day. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, while being supported to perform at your best.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape the technical direction of an enterprise data and analytics platform, apply for the Principal Data Platform Engineer role by 9 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Azure Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Senior Azure Architect får du en central rolle i platformens tekniske udvikling. Du bliver medansvarlig for, at FMP har en tydelig arkitektur, kan skaleres på tværs af kunder og samtidig er sikker, driftsvenlig og enkel at videreudvikle.

Du arbejder både strategisk og hands-on. Du skal kunne drive en designproces og træffe tekniske beslutninger, men også være tæt nok på implementeringen til at sikre, at arkitekturen fungerer i praksis.

Dine Arbejdsopgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være

Sætte teknisk retning for FMP og omsætte den til konkrete, prioriterede forbedringer
Designe standardiserede og skalerbare løsninger på tværs af kundemiljøer
Drive teknisk afklaring og udarbejde korte, præcise designdokumenter
Sikre sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, sikkerhed, governance, drift og kundeoplevelse
Kvalificere komplekse kundekrav og omsætte dem til genanvendelige funktioner og services
Foretage tekniske reviews og sikre kvalitet i design og implementering
Identificere teknisk gæld, risici og muligheder for automatisering
Understøtte onboarding af komplekse kunder og håndtere tekniske eskalationer
Sparre med kunder, arkitekter og interne interessenter om roadmap og løsningsvalg
Mentorere kolleger og bidrage til at løfte teamets tekniske niveau
Skabe fælles standarder, dokumentation og beslutningsgrundlag
Bidrage aktivt til implementering, fejlsøgning og proof of concepts, når opgaven kræver det

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Det betyder blandt andet, at vi skaber fælles kontekst, før vi implementerer, begrænser mængden af igangværende arbejde og prioriterer små leverancer, der hurtigt kan valideres.

I rollen får du et særligt ansvar for, at designafklaringen har den rette kvalitet. Det handler ikke om at producere tunge arkitekturdokumenter, men om at gøre mål, afhængigheder, risici, test og væsentlige beslutninger tydelige, mensdet stadig er billigt at ændre retning.

Du bliver ikke den eneste, der må træffe tekniske beslutninger. En vigtig del af rollen er netop at skabe rammer, viden og fælles principper, så teamet kan tage et bredere teknisk ejerskab.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får en central rolle i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande, og platformensbeslutninger skal derfor kunne fungere i flere organisatoriske og kundemæssige sammenhænge.

Vi lykkes som team og forventer, at du bidrager med både teknisk retning og plads til andres perspektiver. Rollen handler ikke om at være den person, der har alle svarene, men om at hjælpe teamet med at stille de rigtige spørgsmålog træffe holdbare beslutninger.

Om dine komptencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en solid baggrund inden for Azure, cloudarkitektur eller platform engineering og har erfaring med at tage teknisk ansvar for løsninger, der skal være robuste, sikre og skalerbare over tid. Du har arbejdet hands-on med Azure-platformen og designet arkitekturer, hvor sikkerhed, governance, drift og fleksibilitet har været centrale hensyn. Samtidig er du komfortabel med Infrastructure as Code, automatisering og CI/CD og ser værdien i at bygge platforme, der er enkle at vedligeholde og nemme at videreudvikle.

Som person er du i stand til at omsætte komplekse forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til en klar teknisk retning. Du kan hurtigt identificere de væsentligste risici og afvejninger i en løsning og træffe velbegrundede beslutninger på den baggrund. Derudover formår du at kommunikere arkitektur og tekniske valg på en måde, der giver mening for både specialister, kunder og beslutningstagere.

Det er også vigtigt for os, at du trives i en rolle, hvor du gør andre bedre. Du har erfaring med faglig sparring, tekniske reviews eller mentoring og motiveres af at dele viden og skabe retning uden selv at blive en flaskehals for teamet. Du arbejder godt i krydsfeltet mellem langsigtet platformudvikling og konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du både bidrager strategisk og får tingene til at ske i praksis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har dyb erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Azure landing zones og platformarkitektur
Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende Infrastructure as Code
Azure DevOps, Git, branchingstrategier og CI/CD
Platform engineering og self-service-koncepter
Security by design og Zero Trust
Monitorering, logging, observability og incident management
Cloud Adoption Framework og Well-Architected Framework
FinOps og optimering af cloudforbrug
Produktudvikling eller udvikling af fælles platformskapabiliteter

Om dig

Du tager ansvar for helheden og interesserer dig både for den tekniske løsning, teamets arbejdsgang og den værdi, kunden oplever.

Du kan træffe beslutninger, når det er nødvendigt, men er samtidig nysgerrig på andres perspektiver. Du bruger review og faglig uenighed til at forbedre løsningen frem for til at forsvare dit eget forslag.

Du er pragmatisk og kan skelne mellem beslutninger, der kræver grundig afklaring, og detaljer, der med fordel kan vente. Du ved også, at en arkitektur først har værdi, når teamet kan forstå, implementere og drive den.

Når noget går galt, søger du efter årsagen i systemet og arbejdsformen frem for efter den skyldige. Du deler din viden aktivt og arbejder bevidst på at gøre teamet mindre afhængigt af enkeltpersoner.

jobs.description:
Date: 24 Sept 2026

Company: Singapore Pools (Pte) Ltd

Work that powers communities.

Who We Are

Singapore Pools was established by the Singapore government on 23 May 1968 to provide safe and trusted betting to counter illegal gambling. As a not-for-profit organisation, it makes contributions to the Tote Board to fund a wide range of causes in social service, community development, sports, arts, education and health sectors.

Since 2004, over $5 billion have been channelled to the Tote Board. In addition, Singapore Pools also contributes about $2 billion annually to the Government in the form of taxes and duties. Its responsible gaming practices have been awarded the highest level of certification (Level 4) by the World Lottery Association’s Responsible Gaming Framework since 2012.

Since inception, Singapore Pools’ staff have a long-standing commitment to doing good and giving back to those in need. Staff volunteers support activities held all year round, from helping disadvantaged children, youth-at-risk, underprivileged families, and elderly, to conserving the environment.

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) drives enterprise operational resilience by architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, managing the enterprise DevOps toolchain, and ensuring centralized system observability across hybrid cloud environments. Leveraging a strong software engineering background, the SRE implements GitOps methodologies and develops custom automation applications and API-based services. By heavily utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GenAI tools, this role eliminates manual operations, drives efficiency, optimizes cloud expenditures, and ensures maximum system uptime against stringent SLAs.

What You'll Do

Software Engineering & Automation: Write code and develop automated, API-based applications (including GenAI integrations) to streamline operational reporting and eliminate recurring manual tasks.
Reliability & Operations: Implement SRE best practices for observability, availability, performance, and incident response. Define, measure, and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets in collaboration with product engineering teams. Participate in on-call rotations, execute postmortem/RCAs, and identify/fix production bottlenecks.
Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure: Support product teams in building fault-tolerant applications by enforcing infrastructure deployment via rigorous IaC code reviews.
CI/CD & Toolchain: Maintain DevOps systems and enforce GitOps workflows and integrate automated security/vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines for all application, container, and IaC deployment approvals.
Observability: Create and maintain consolidated operations dashboards by integrating telemetry from disparate monitoring tools and native AWS/Azure metrics.
FinOps: Generate actionable FinOps reporting to track and optimize hybrid cloud spending.
Resilience & Documentation: Execute disaster recovery (DR), backup, redundancy, and capacity planning strategies while maintaining high-quality runbooks and operational documentation.

Who You Are

Degree-qualified in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science or related IT Discipline, with 4 to 7 years of proven, hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, DevOps, or SRE roles.
Hold professional certifications such as ITIL, FinOps Certified Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate), Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).
Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Deep hands-on experience building scalable hybrid cloud infrastructures (AWS and Azure) and containerization. Strong understanding of modern hosting, networking design patterns, and applying the Six Pillars of operational excellence across environments.
Software Engineering: Strong background building production-level software in Python, Golang, or Java. Experience developing and deploying API-based services and serverless applications on AWS Lambda and Azure Functions.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): High proficiency in IaC and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) and container orchestration systems (e.g., Kubernetes). Proven capability in enforcing deployment pipelines through rigorous code review processes and working within Agile methodologies.
Version Control: Proficient in Git, including advanced branching strategies and GitOps paradigms.
Systems Knowledge: Deep expertise in architecting and managing centralized Observability platforms, utilizing GenAI, time-series databases, and diverse monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk, InfluxDB) to trace distributed cloud applications. Solid understanding of Database Administration and Networking architecture.
Professional & Interpersonal Skills: Ability to make sound, logical, data-based decisions on complex issues while considering risks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong interest in technological trends and disruptions impacting Cloud Engineering and SRE.

What We Offer

Comprehensive total rewards package
Health & wellness benefits
Continuous learning and upskilling opportunities
Volunteerism and community initiatives

Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions for AI tooling (LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks) based on client requirements, cost, and data sensitivity
Apply security and compliance thinking specific to AI systems: data leakage risks, prompt injection, access control on retrieved content, and responsible handling of client data used in AI pipelines

You will actively contribute to the design and development of AI agents, enterprise knowledge assistants, RAG-based applications, document-processing solutions and AI-enabled software development workflows. The primary objective is to integrate AI technologies with enterprise systems and turn them into reliable, sustainable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Design and develop single-agent and multi-agent architectures and agentic workflows.

Compare models and solution architectures based on response quality, task-completion performance, latency, security and operating cost.
Incorporate human-in-the-loop controls, authorization, approvals, stop conditions, fallback strategies and rollback mechanisms into agent workflows.
Work on prompt and context management, model selection, token usage, latency and cost optimization.
Integrate the principles of KVKK compliance, Responsible AI and enterprise information security throughout the solution lifecycle.
Develop solutions that support the controlled use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Kiro across software design, coding, testing, documentation and code-review processes.

Document architectural decisions, integrations, solution behaviour, technical limitations and operational requirements.
Contribute to shared AI platform standards by developing reusable prompts, agents, connectors, evaluation assets and orchestration components.
Monitor production AI solutions after deployment and continuously improve them based on user feedback, quality metrics, failure analysis and business outcomes.
Keep up to date with emerging GenAI, Agentic AI and LLM technologies and evaluate their applicability to enterprise needs.

Knowledge and experience in REST APIs, SQL, relational data structures, authentication and authorization.
