jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Dutch speaking)
jobs.description:
👋 Wie we zijn
Bij Nimble bouwen we hoogwaardige digitale producten die het leven van mensen makkelijker maken. Geen poeha, geen jargon, gewoon slimme, intuïtieve tools die echte problemen oplossen. Of het nu gaat om een nieuw fintech-platform, een dashboard voor de zorgsector of een intern tool voor een scale-up: we helpen bedrijven snel van idee naar impact.
We zijn een hecht team van designers, developers en strategen, gevestigd in Gent, en werken hybride. Je brengt de helft van je dagen door in ons gezellig kantoor in de buurt van het stadscentrum, en de andere helft waar jij het beste werkt. Als Full-Stack Engineer sta je middenin het geheel: je vormt, bouwt en shipt producten die onder de motorkap robuust zijn en aan de oppervlakte fijn om te gebruiken. Je beweegt vlot tussen front-end en back-end en zorgt dat alles naadloos samenwerkt.

💼 Wat ga je doen
Je neemt ownership over de volledige stack: van slick UI's tot betrouwbare API's en databases.
Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met product designers en PM's, zodat wat je bouwt technisch sterk staat én gebruiksvriendelijk is.
Je helpt nieuwe producten mee opstarten met de juiste setup en tools, zodat schaalbaarheid er vanaf dag één in zit.
Je valideert en verfijnt je oplossingen door samen te werken met teamleden, grondig te testen en snel te itereren.
Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in webdevelopment en experimenteert met moderne frameworks, libraries en AI-tools wanneer het zinvol is.
Je deelt je perspectief met klanten, daagt ideeën constructief uit en toont je werk met trots.
Je bent een teamplayer: je geeft en ontvangt feedback, begeleidt andere developers en draagt bij aan herbruikbare code en documentatie.

🧠 Wie jij bent
Een full-stack engineer met minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring.
Je voelt je thuis in zowel front-end (React, TypeScript, Tailwind…) als back-end (Node, API's, databases…).
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en staat te popelen om te ontdekken hoe je het kan toepassen in echte digitale producten.
Iemand die floreert in een agile, iteratieve omgeving en niet bang is om vanaf nul te beginnen.
Je spreekt vloeiend Engels en Nederlands.
Je gelooft dat feedback brandstof is voor groei — je geeft het eerlijk en ontvangt het open.
Je wordt gedreven door impact: je wil dingen bouwen die mensen écht gebruiken en die er écht toe doen.

🎁 Wat wij jou bieden
Wij geloven in een werkplek waar mensen fantastisch werk kunnen leveren en tegelijk plezier beleven aan de rit. Dit is wat we bieden:
💰 Je loon bij Nimble is gebaseerd op de ownership die je opneemt en de impact die je creëert.
🏡 Hybride setup: 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Gent, 2 dagen van thuis uit.
🧘 Jaarlijkse sluiting tussen Kerst en Nieuwjaar, want rust voedt creativiteit.
🧠 Mentale ondersteuning via een toegewijde externe partner.
👾 Bouw en experimenteer met een moderne stack: Mastra, Qdrant of PGVector, Expo en Terraform.
💪🏻 Sport wanneer je maar wil bij "Healthworks Gym" om de hoek.
💻 Topmateriaal: MacBook, monitor, de volledige uitrusting.
📚 Jaarlijks budget voor learning & research & development: boeken, cursussen, events, jij kiest.
✈️ Jaarlijkse teamtrip: samen plezier maken, brainstormen en out-of-the-box denken.
🏥 Privéhospitalisatieverzekering (Alan).

🙌 Klinkt dit als jou? Denk je dat je waarde kan toevoegen bij Nimble? Dan horen we graag van je. Ook als je ervaring niet elk vakje afvinkt: solliciteer gerust. We zijn altijd benieuwd om mensen te ontmoeten die iets unieks meebrengen. Is er een klik? Dan zoeken we er samen wel uit.

🌈 Wij zijn een gelijkekansenwerkgever.
Bij Nimble verwelkomen we iedereen, van alle achtergronden, levenswandels en identiteiten. We geloven dat een divers team ons helpt betere, meer menselijke producten te bouwen.
We moedigen sollicitaties van ondervertegenwoordigde groepen in tech en gemarginaliseerde gemeenschappen sterk aan: vrouwen, mensen van kleur, LGBTQIA+'ers, ouders, mensen die van carrière veranderen, vluchtelingen, mensen met een beperking… wie je ook bent, jij hoort hier thuis.
Alle kandidaten worden beoordeeld zonder rekening te houden met ras, religie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, nationale afkomst, neurodiversiteit, beperking, leeftijd, of iets anders dat niets te maken heeft met je talent en potentieel.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content. 
The role you'll play 

We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one. 
The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows. 
The team you'll be a part of 

You'll be one of the founding members of a brand-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set. 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by... 

Developing and maintaining applications, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and databases 

Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements 

Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation 

Ensuring high-quality software through active participation in code reviews 

Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand-ups, and other team processes 

Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests 

Leveraging AI-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor 

Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams 

Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings 

Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations 

In one year, you'll know you were successful if... 

You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships. 

You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge-sharing team atmosphere. 

You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact. 

You share your expertise by mentoring mid-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed. 

You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision-making. 

Desired Experience And Competencies 

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

What you'll need to bring 

Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment. 

Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices. 

Extensive experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.) 

Experience with Python 

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET 

Responsible for front-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full-stack and frontend developers 

Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar). 

Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices 

Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end). 

Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring 

Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, and QA. 

DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP). 

This will make you stand out 

Knowledge of microservices architecture and event-driven systems 

Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL 

Hands-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ 

Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) 

Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation) 

Awareness of security best practices in software development 

Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge-sharing within the team 

Our perks 

Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas   

Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture   

International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia   

We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!    

150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments    

Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square   

Private health insurance   

We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.   

Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities   

A dog friendly atmosphere    

Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.   

Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)   

Bike and car parking  

About LanguageWire  

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.   

Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.   

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don't understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.  

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:   

"Once the purpose & values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level." 
(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)  

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion   

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.  
LanguageWire's recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.  

Want to know more?   
We can't wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!   
If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

En BETWEEN apostamos por el mejor talento dentro del sector tecnológico. Nos involucramos en una gran variedad de proyectos punteros, trabajando con las últimas tecnologías. Actualmente en BETWEEN contamos con un equipo de más de 800 personas.

Participar en el diseño y definición técnica de las soluciones.
Configurar equipos, sistemas y aplicaciones.
Realizar despliegues y puestas en marcha.
Ejecutar y documentar pruebas FAT/SAT, pruebas unitarias y de regresión.
Diagnosticar incidencias relacionadas con software, redes, comunicaciones industriales, bases de datos o configuración.
Analizar logs e identificar la causa raíz de los problemas.
Mantener interlocución técnica con el cliente durante el proyecto.
Documentar configuraciones, pruebas, incidencias y modificaciones.
Preparar informes técnicos, manuales y documentación de proyecto.
Formar al personal del cliente en el uso de la solución.
Coordinarse internamente con Project Managers, Business Analysts, desarrollo y otras áreas técnicas.

¿Cómo lo haré? Tendrás a tu alcance:

Contrato indefinido
Jornada completa
Horario flexible: lunes a Jueves jornada de 8,5 horas entrada entre 8h-9h, y viernes intensiva de 6 horas
Modalidad Híbrida 1-2 días de teletrabajo a la semana.
Disponibilidad para viajar aprox, 20-30% del tiempo de trabajo anual.

Seguro médico gratuito.
Dispondrás de oportunidades de formación y desarrollo profesional: Idiomas, cursos en Udemy, Certificaciones, Programa The Power Business School y Bootcamps especializados (Agile, DevOps, IA & Big Data, Ciberseguridad, etc.).
Contarás con un equipo de Talento que te acompañará durante toda tu experiencia con nosotros. ¡Haremos un café una vez al mes! Así, mantendremos el contacto.
Posibilidad de elegir cómo obtener parte de tu salario gracias a las ventajas fiscales de nuestra Retribución Flexible (Ticket restaurant, Ticket transporte, Ticket guardería).
Descuentos para acceder a centros de Fitness con Gympass.
Acceso a nuestro Club de Descuentos: Inspiring Benefits.
Programa remunerado de recomendación de Talento.

Puesta en marcha de equipos, sistemas o soluciones industriales.
Protocolos como Modbus y EtherNet/IP.
Lectura y análisis de logs.
Experiencia con entorno Microsoft (APIS, .NET,etc)
C# y SQL, aunque no necesitamos un desarrollador puro.
Docker como conocimiento valorable.
Jira, Confluence y metodologías ágiles.
Pruebas, validación y documentación técnica.
Ingles minimo B2

Partner with pharma clients from pilot to production — leading technical onboarding, integration, and go-live

Debug integration issues in production, triage model behavior, and coordinate with internal engineering teams on fixes

Engineering

In the first 30 days, you're embedded with a client team and have shipped at least one integration. In 90 days, you're running deployments independently and have become the go-to technical resource for your accounts.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers
to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking a curious and versatile Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with a strong track record of deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting complex virtualization and cloud environments. As part of our VDI Lab team, you will be responsible for building and evolving the environments that our product teams rely on — standing up new VDI platforms, thin client operating systems, and cloud desktop services, and researching how to integrate emerging technologies into our infrastructure.

Because the position is highly cross-functional, the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and pragmatic way is essential. You will work side by side with product and engineering teams, and your work will become the foundation on which our endpoint capabilities are built and validated across virtualization and cloud desktop platforms.

Responsibilities

Build and evolve the virtualization environments our endpoint products run on, across the major VDI and cloud desktop platforms.
Automate it end to end: infrastructure as code, provisioning and image pipelines, so any engineer can get a working desktop on demand.
Keep it running across public cloud and on-prem — networking, identity, and monitoring.
Evaluate and integrate emerging endpoint technologies, from proof of concept to supported platform.
Work with product managers, engineering teams, and technology partners to unlock and validate new platform coverage.
Be the person other teams come to when they need to understand how a virtualization platform behaves.

Qualifications

Must have

BSc/BEng or master's in computer science, or equivalent experience
5+ years of professional cloud infrastructure experience
Deep hands-on experience with at least one major VDI/EUC platform — Citrix CVAD, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft AVD / Windows 365, or Amazon WorkSpaces — and willingness to learn the others
Strong Windows Server and hybrid identity foundations (Active Directory, Entra ID)
A bias toward automation — Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or whatever you've used to stop clicking through the same setup twice
English proficiency.

Where you've built depth
— we don't expect all of these; tell us which are yours

Additional VDI platforms, brokers, or gateways (NetScaler/ADC, UAG)
Hypervisor administration (vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and golden image lifecycle — build, optimization, patching, FSLogix
Networking for virtual desktops — VLANs, firewalling, TLS, site-to-site VPN to AWS or Azure
Cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS, and CI/CD or image pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Packer)
Secure administration — RBAC, PIM, secrets management, vulnerability management
Thin client and endpoint management — IGEL UMS, Dell Wyse Management Suite, Intune
Synthetic testing / benchmarking — Login Enterprise (Login VSI) or similar

How you work

You can explain a platform constraint to a product manager and a design trade-off to an engineer on the same day
You're drawn to unfamiliar technology rather than wary of it — this role puts something new in front of you every quarter

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!  Check what we offer:

Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

The base salary for this role is €42,000 – €70,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of €46,000 – €77,000 including an annual performance bonus. You'll also be part of our broader total rewards package — including benefits tailored to where you live and how you work best.

We set our pay ranges using objective criteria: the scope and level of the role, the skills it takes to do it well, and the relevant market data. Ranges are reviewed every year to remain competitive and fair. We're transparent about this because we think you deserve to know what you're working towards from day one. In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), we publish salary ranges on every Nexthink role. We won't ask what you currently earn or your previous salary. What matters to us is what this role is worth and whether it works for you. Nexthinkers come from all kinds of backgrounds, and that's what makes us stronger. We welcome applications from everyone.

Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

The role:

As an AI Architect, you will design and guide production-ready Generative AI solutions for clients, from early discovery through implementation. This role combines hands-on architecture, technical leadership, and client collaboration. You will help teams choose where Generative AI adds value, build secure and scalable solutions, and measure their quality and cost in production.

Your responsibilities will include:

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Lead the architecture and delivery of Generative AI solutions, guiding development teams on relevant tools, frameworks, and platforms.
Translate business requirements into robust application, service, and target-state architectures, including reusable RAG, agent orchestration, prompt, and evaluation patterns.
Own scalability, performance, latency, observability, security, and cost optimisation across AI solutions.
Lead technical design and code reviews and guide delivery against client needs and quality standards.
Define the right adaptation approach for each use case—prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, or distillation—including when Generative AI is not appropriate.

AI Quality, Security & Operations

Own evaluation strategy, including golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, human-calibrated LLM-as-judge, and CI regression testing.
Set retrieval quality standards for chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and permission-aware retrieval, using measured recall and precision.
Define AI security, privacy, Responsible AI, and governance controls, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak, sandboxing, least-privilege identity, and supply-chain risks.
Own solution economics through model routing, caching, batching, capacity planning, and defensible cost-per-transaction estimates.
Support enterprise architecture standards and help assess technology solutions.

Leadership, Clients & Practice

Supervise vendor developers and mentor engineers and junior architects.
Support business development by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Improve internal design and development practices and maintain documentation.
Build internal relationships, strengthen the firm's reputation, and develop your skills in line with company and team priorities.
Take on additional responsibilities relevant to the role and agreed with your manager.

Experience

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience in agile product delivery.
Hands-on experience designing and delivering production software solutions at scale.
Demonstrated expertise in Generative AI solution architecture.
You have personally delivered at least one Generative AI system to production and can explain its architecture, failure modes, operating costs, and lessons learned.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant Microsoft Azure certification, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate, is preferred.

Technical Skills & Specialized Knowledge

Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI architecture is essential. Experience across several relevant technologies is expected; expertise in every named tool is not required.

Generative AI & Agent Architecture

Large language models such as GPT-4, Gemini, and Llama.
RAG, agent orchestration, and Microsoft Copilots using platforms or frameworks such as Azure OpenAI Service, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
Vector search and retrieval engineering, including chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, and permission-aware retrieval.
Production AI agents, including tool calls, state and memory management, durable execution, approval controls, retries, idempotency, and cost safeguards.
Structured generation, including schema-enforced outputs, validation and repair, deterministic fallbacks, and graceful degradation.

Cloud, Software & Data Engineering

Cloud-native Azure architecture, including Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and appropriate infrastructure and platform services.
Service-oriented, event-driven, and microservices architectures.
Relational and NoSQL data stores, such as Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, with sound technology-selection judgement.
Containers and orchestration using Docker and/or Kubernetes.
DevOps and delivery practices, including CI/CD, automation, environment management, and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, or Jira.
Working knowledge of user-centred product practices, including user stories, personas, and prototyping.

Evaluation, Operations & Security

AI evaluation using golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, and prompt and model regression testing.
LLMOps and observability, including tracing, token and cost attribution, prompt and model versioning, trace replay, and quality-drift monitoring, using tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or Azure Monitor.
Model economics, including routing, cascading, caching, batching, and provisioned-versus-consumption capacity planning.
AI security, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak resistance, sandboxing, least-privilege identities, supply-chain risk, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

Nice to Have

Model Context Protocol and agent interoperability standards.
Model adaptation beyond prompting and RAG, including fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and distillation.
Multimodal AI, including document intelligence, vision, speech, or voice agents.
AI regulation and assurance frameworks, including the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, and NIST AI RMF.
Consulting or professional-services experience with external clients.

Strategic, analytical problem-solving with attention to detail.
Leadership, troubleshooting, curiosity, and creativity.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Clear written and verbal communication with product teams, clients, and stakeholders.
Strong collaboration and client focus, with the ability to understand needs, use feedback, and support timely, high-quality delivery.

Sound judgement about where Generative AI adds value and where a simpler solution is more appropriate.

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++

Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. new_jobs.title: Software Security Designer – Cyber Resilience Act / IEC
new_jobs.description:
At Sioux Technologies, cybersecurity is rapidly becoming a core engineering discipline. Rather than treating security as an afterthought, we help our customers design cyber-resilient products from the earliest system concepts onward.

In this role you help our customers develop cyber-resilient high-tech products that comply with the latest European cybersecurity legislation and industrial security standards.

You work on complex systems in the semiconductor, medical, analytical instrumentation and industrial automation domains, translating cybersecurity requirements into practical software solutions.

What excites you as a Software Security Designer – Cyber Resilience Act / IEC?

From any Sioux office in the Netherlands, you will work in mono-disciplinary and multidisciplinary teams to design, implement and validate secure software that meets regulatory requirements and industry-standard security frameworks.

You enjoy:

Translating a security architecture into software design
Performing software security design reviews and implementing secure-by-design principles.
Supporting threat modelling (STRIDE, OWASP, attack trees, misuse cases).
Performing cybersecurity risk assessments and defining security requirements for embedded and application software.
Implementing authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communication.
Improving software supply chain security (SBOMs, dependency management, vulnerability management).
Developing CRA and IEC 62443 compliant software.

Sounds good so far? We’d love to tell you more…..

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You combine extensive software engineering experience with deep knowledge of secure product development, helping customers implement security throughout the entire software lifecycle.

To be successful in this role, you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
More than 7 years of experience in software development (C++, C#, Java, and/or embedded software) within the medical technology, semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and/or industrial automation industries.
Demonstrable experience in implementing security requirements for products subject to one or more of the following regulations: CRA, NIS2, and AIA.
Experience with one or more of the following security standards: IEC 62443, IEC 81001, and ISO/IEC 27001.
Experience with threat modeling and vulnerability management (CVE, CVSS, PSIRT).
Experience generating Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and securing the software supply chain.
Experience with secure coding guidelines (such as CERT, MISRA, and OWASP) and working in Agile, DevOps, and DevSecOps environments.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
You will be working at a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. You will be working on the Sioux Campus and can use our Sioux Labs living room every day for lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

new_jobs.title: Platform Engineer Azure en Kubernetes
new_jobs.description:
In het kort

De afdeling Software Services zorgt ervoor dat al onze klanten zelf of via hun adviseur online hun hypotheek kunnen regelen. Wij maken dit mogelijk door het realiseren van maatwerkapplicaties waarmee we onze adviseurs, klanten en medewerkers optimaal kunnen bedienen. Dit doen we met meerdere teams die het DevOps ideaal in de praktijk brengen. Het platformteam is daarin een cruciale factor.

Je werk

We zoeken een software engineer met ervaring met en/of ambities naar platform engineer. In ons platform team tillen we development teams naar een hoger niveau door Infrastructuur as Code, templates, self-service oplossingen en andere resources aan te leveren zodat de teams snel waarde kunnen leveren met hun applicaties op Kubernetes. Ook ontwikkelen we zelf een aantal business gedreven Frontend en Backend applicaties zodat we zelf onze eerste klant zijn. Dit betekent dat we altijd op zoek zijn naar verbeteringen in onze code, stack en kennis. Voor elk teamlid is het blijven leren en verbeteren is daarbij belangrijk. Daar krijg je dan ook elke kans voor. Het is belangrijker dat je oog hebt voor kwaliteit en graag leert dan dat je specifieke tools en technieken al beheerst.

We zijn een gezellig team van specialisten; samen brainstormen en het oplossen van problemen staan bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Daarnaast zijn we een vraagbaak voor collega's uit andere teams en helpen we hen vaak met onze kennis en ideeën. De kennis die je nog niet hebt doe je graag op en nieuwe uitdagingen pak je met beide handen aan. Als deze mindset bij je past, is Team B een grote kans om je kennis en kunde uit te breiden en aan te scherpen.

Werkomgeving

Ons kantoor is gevestigd in Amersfoort, vlak bij het station, en de sfeer op onze afdeling is gezellig en ontspannen. Passie voor je vak, ondernemerschap en vakmanschap vinden wij belangrijk op de afdeling. De cultuur is informeel, wij zijn open naar elkaar, vieren successen en organiseren regelmatig afdelingsuitjes. We zien onze collega's graag 1 of 2 dagen per week op kantoor. De overige dagen werken we vanuit huis. We zoeken iemand met academisch/ HBO opleidings- en werkniveau die beschikbaar is voor 32, 36 of 40 uur. Onze voertaal is Nederlands omdat onze business ook volledig Nederlands opereert.

Je profiel

Je hebt kennis van Kubernetes (liefst AKS); bonuspunten voor ervaring met kubernetes-tooling zoals Istio, Calico, Helm en Prometheus;
Je kunt je door programmeerervaring binnen het Microsoft-domein goed verplaatsen in de behoeften van andere .NET-ontwikkelaars;
Je hebt affiniteit met Platform Engineering;
Je verkent graag nieuwe clouddiensten binnen Azure en weet die op een veilige manier te ontsluiten voor andere ontwikkelaars (en je eigen team);
Je voelt je thuis in de wereld van CI/CD, IaC, pipelines, git en shift-left;
Security, schaalbaarheid en robuustheid van onze oplossingen verlies je niet uit het oog;
Je excelleert in .NET en bouwt daarmee graag nieuwe microservices;
Je bent trots op je werk en presenteert je ideeën en resultaten graag aan andere ontwikkelaars.
Je beschikt over een minimum van B2 Nederlands in woord en geschrift

Wij bieden

Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar,dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privégebruik.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze cao die van toepassing is op deze vacature.

Interesse?

Dan ontvangen we graag je cv & motivatiebrief.

Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in " Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd
sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

Als je wilt solliciteren voor het B-Able of Reboot programma, zorg er dan voor dat je dit vermeldt zowel in de titel als in de inhoud van je cv.

Disclaimer externe recruitmentbureaus

Externe recruitmentbureaus dienen een overeenkomst met ABN AMRO BANK N.V. te hebben getekend, uitgegeven door een Talent Acquisition Specialist, om cv's te mogen indienen. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

Gebruik van AI tijdens sollicitatieproces

Je mag AI gebruiken om je cv en motivatiebrief te schrijven, zolang het jouw eigen verhaal blijft en laat zien wie jij bent. We kijken met aandacht naar elke sollicitatie en doen dat altijd persoonlijk, zonder AI. Tijdens gesprekken is het gebruik van real time AI niet toegestaan. Met jouw toestemming kunnen gesprekken worden opgenomen en ondersteund door AI. Zo zorgen we samen voor een eerlijk, zorgvuldig en transparant sollicitatieproces.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer (Back-End) | Talent Program
Pega Test Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet alleen technologie transformatie aandrijft, maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom staan mensen centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

In Nederland werk je binnen RulesMatter. Een betrokken, inhoudelijk sterk team dat organisaties helpt hun processen slimmer en toekomstbestendig te maken met regelgebaseerde technologie. Binnen onze Technical Business Process Automation practice bouwen we met Pega oplossingen die niet alleen werken, maar ook betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar zijn.

We bouwen geen losse features. We bouwen processen die blijven staan.

The world is how we shape it.

Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Als Pega Test Engineer zorg jij dat wat we bouwen ook écht goed werkt. Jij kijkt verder dan een geslaagde testcase. Je denkt mee over risico’s, kwaliteit en samenhang. Waar kan het misgaan? Wat missen we nog? En hoe maken we het beter voordat het in productie gaat?

Je werkt aan Pega-applicaties binnen complexe omgevingen. Samen met developers, analisten en architecten zorg je dat testing geen sluitpost is, maar vanaf het begin onderdeel van het ontwerp.

In deze rol houd je je vooral bezig met:

Het bepalen van een slimme testaanpak binnen Pega-projecten
Het ontwerpen en uitvoeren van testscenario’s op functioneel en technisch niveau
Het opzetten en verbeteren van testautomatisering waar dat waarde toevoegt

Je werkt hybride vanuit Groningen, gecombineerd met klantlocaties en thuis. Binnen RulesMatter werk je in een multidisciplinair team waar kwaliteit geen bijzaak is, maar vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van hoe we werken.

Functie-eisen

Dit zijn jouw sterktes

Je hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit en neemt geen genoegen met “het zal wel goed zijn”. Je stelt vragen, denkt vooruit en durft ook tegen te spreken als iets niet klopt. Je begrijpt hoe processen werken en weet waar risico’s zich kunnen verstoppen.

Wat we bij jou terugzien:

Ervaring als tester in complexe applicatieomgevingen
Ervaring met testautomatisering, bijvoorbeeld met Tosca, Selenium of Cucumber
Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende testniveaus en stakeholders
Je voelt je prettig in een Agile omgeving
Je spreekt Nederlands op minimaal B2-niveau

Ervaring met Pega is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Als jij de basis van testdenken goed beheerst en de motivatie hebt om je verder te verdiepen, helpen wij je daarbij.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en inschaling
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes;
Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;
Hybride werken: thuis, op ons kantoor in Groningen of bij de klant, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt;
Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget, in de vorm van een leaseregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatief vervoersregeling. Net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;
Winstdeling van 8% on target;
27 betaalde vakantiedagen;
Mogelijkheid om op fiscaal vriendelijke manier studieschuld af te lossen, een fiets, zonnepanelen of sportabonnementen aan te schaffen (Cafetaria-systeem) of andere personeelskortingen te verkrijgen;
Een internetvergoeding van €15 netto per maand, een aanvullende thuiswerkvergoeding van €21,50 netto per maand waarbij wij jou daarbij faciliteiten bieden voor de uitrusting van jouw eigen thuiskantoor;
Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kan toevoegen.

Je sluit je aan bij onze area RulesMatter. Een team met korte lijnen, veel inhoud en collega’s die elkaar scherp houden zonder gedoe.

Reageer gerust. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

zu.

Role: Solution Architect - Data Platform

🟡 Languages: Fluent Polish & English
🟡 Location: 100% remote or hybrid - you choose. You can always book a desk in our office in our office in Warsaw or Cracow
🟡 Salary: B2B contract 150-200 PLN h/net + VAT
🟡 Long-term cooperation

You'll design data platforms and enterprise-scale data solutions on Azure, working across architecture, implementation and client needs. The role combines hands-on architectural work with close collaboration with implementation teams and stakeholders, from shaping the solution to supporting its delivery.

What you'll actually work on?

Gather requirements and translate business and technical needs into data platform architectures.
Design enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses, ETL processes and Machine Learning solutions.
Identify where AI can add value within a data platform and help clients translate potential use cases into practical platform requirements.
Consider how data platforms should evolve to support AI-driven solutions, taking into account data availability, access, governance and scalability.
Define architecture across connectivity, authentication and authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Work with clients on data strategy and help shape practical approaches to adopting and modernizing cloud data platforms.
Prepare cloud adoption roadmaps, project documentation, estimations and delivery timelines.
Support implementation teams from concept through delivery, providing architectural guidance and helping resolve complex technical challenges.
Stay close to evolving Data Platform and AI architecture patterns and assess how new capabilities can be applied to real project needs.

What you'll work with?

Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic.
You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company.
Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

What collaboration with Elitmind looks like?

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.
Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.
Strong Data & AI expertise

Collaborate with experienced Data & AI experts across different areas, technologies and enterprise projects.
Technology that keeps moving

Work across the Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake ecosystems, with new technologies regularly explored and applied to real business challenges.
Different projects, different challenges

Our projects span different industries, technologies and business contexts, so there's always something new to solve.
Real autonomy

Take ownership of your scope and independently organize how you deliver the agreed outcomes.

Flexibility that works around your life

Choose where you work best and organize your working hours with flexibility. Work remotely or book a desk in our office whenever you want to collaborate or meet the team in person.

What we're looking for?

Strong practical knowledge of Azure and its data platform ecosystem.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses or Delta Lake solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including modern capabilities such as Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog.
Good understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking and identity components.

new_jobs.title: Systemutvecklare C# /.NET Azure | Tekniska verken
new_jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla digitala tjänster i en av Sveriges mest spännande branscher? Energibranschen genomgår en omfattande förändring där digitalisering och smarta lösningar spelar en avgörande roll för framtiden. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa generations digitala kundupplevelser för energibranschen! Hos oss på Tekniska Verken får du arbeta med modern systemutveckling i Azure och samtidigt bidra till ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag.

Det här är en direktrekrytering till Tekniska verken, hanterad av Experis.

Hos oss blir du en del av något större

Vi på Division Digitalisering befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsresa där vi bygger framtidens digitala förmågor för Tekniska verken. Som utvecklare tillhör du Digital Produktutveckling som ansvarar för utveckling av våra egna produkter och tjänster som möter våra kunder. Du utvecklar lösningar som hjälper människor att förstå sin energianvändning, hantera sina abonnemang, följa sina fakturor, beställa tjänster, få information om driftstörningar och bidra till energiomställningen. Våra system hanterar stora mängder data från mätare, energisystem, kundplattformar och IoT-lösningar, där tillgänglighet, skalbarhet och säkerhet är avgörande.

Rollbeskrivning

I rollen som Systemutvecklare blir du en viktig del av vår satsning inom digital produktutveckling. Du kommer att arbeta med utveckling och vidareutveckling av våra digitala produkter och tjänster, med särskilt fokus på moderna backendlösningar och integrationer. Här arbetar du nära produktägare, UX, frontendutvecklare, arkitekter och andra backendutvecklare i tvärfunktionella produktteam med ansvar från idé till produktion. Teamen har stor frihet inom de ramar som vår målarkitektur och gemensamma plattform ger.

Rollen i korthet:
• Utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar med fokus på backendutveckling i C# och .NET
• Bygga och förvalta API:er, integrationer och tjänster som stödjer våra digitala produkter
• Arbeta med moderna Azure-baserade lösningar och molntjänster
• Bidra till utveckling av CI/CD-flöden, automatisering och Infrastructure as Code
• Delta i design och utveckling av nya digitala lösningar, bland annat vår kommande företagsportal

Rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta brett inom vår Azure-miljö, där vi använder tekniker och tjänster såsom Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps och CI/CD-flöden. Här får du bygga API:er, integrationer och händelsebaserade lösningar i en modern molnplattform där både applikationer och infrastruktur hanteras som kod. AI är en naturlig del av vår utvecklingsprocess. Vi använder AI-assistenter och agenter för att öka produktiviteten, förbättra kvaliteten och automatisera repetitiva uppgifter, samtidigt som vi ställer höga krav på säkerhet, integritet och kontroll.

Din profil och bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för systemutveckling och som drivs av att skapa lösningar som ger verkligt värde. Du är nyfiken och öppen, både när det kommer till ny teknik, nya idéer och i samarbetet med andra människor. Vi ser också att du är ansvarstagande, har ett gott självledarskap och trivs i en miljö där du får ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Vi värdesätter en pragmatisk inställning och förmågan att bidra till ett positivt och prestigelöst teamklimat.

Vi söker dig som:
• Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller har tillägnat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet
• Har erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C# / .NET i en agil utvecklingsmiljö och trivs med molnbaserade lösningar
• Tycker om att bygga robusta API:er och tjänster och ser värdet av testning, automatisering och DevOps
• Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande för rollen är arbetslivserfarenhet inom någon eller flera av Azure-plattformens tjänster. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av distribuerade system, integrationslösningar, eventdriven arkitektur, IoT, tidsseriedata eller energibranschen. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller har flera års erfarenhet är det viktigaste för oss din nyfikenhet, motivation och vilja att sätta dig in i vår verksamhet och utvecklas tillsammans med oss!

Vårt erbjudande till dig

Hos oss blir du en del av en organisation med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag, där digitalisering och teknik spelar en avgörande roll för att skapa hållbara och samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster. Du är med och hjälper människor att använda energi smartare vilket spelar en viktig roll i den pågående energiomställningen.

Här får du:
• Arbeta med moderna tekniker och plattformar i en Azure-miljö där vi kontinuerligt utvecklar våra arbetssätt och lösningar
• Utvecklas tillsammans med positiva och engagerade kollegor i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och starkt teknikintresse
• Bygga specialistkompetens inom en bransch i förändring, där digitalisering är en viktig möjliggörare för framtidens energisystem

Låter det här intressant?

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Experis. Vid frågor är du välkommen att ta kontakt med våra rekryteringskonsulter Jenny Lilja på jenny.lilja@se.experis.com eller Anki Snis på anki.snis@se.experis.com.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och rekommenderar dig därför att visa ditt intresse så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag är 28/10. Tjänsten är placerad på Tekniska verkens huvudkontor i Linköping.

Vi ser fram emot att veta mer om dig!

Tekniska verken

Tekniska verken är en samhällsbärande aktör som varje dag möjliggör ett fungerande och hållbart liv för invånarna i regionen. Genom att säkra allt från energi och vatten till återvinning och digital infrastruktur skapar vi trygghet, livskvalitet och samhällsviktiga tjänster till hundratusentals invånare och företag i regionen – varje dag. Vår verksamhet märks kanske mest när den inte fungerar, men vårt värde finns i varje hem, varje arbetsplats och varje del av samhället. Läs mer om oss här: https://www.tekniskaverken.se/om-oss/

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)

Collaborating with other team members on new packages

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization
Strong fundamentals in software design (e.g. unit testing, integration testing, dependency injection, design patterns)
A deep interest in tools development: you get more excited about building tooling and setting up efficient workflows than working directly on player-facing game features
An investigative mindset: you’re curious, thorough, and enjoy getting to the bottom of tricky problems
A genuine interest in sharing knowledge: you enjoy bringing people together, explaining how things work and helping them adopt tools

Nice-to-haves

Experience with automated testing of Unity projects, including on-device testing
Experience with graphics and shaders programming
Interest in experimenting with and using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.
You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.
You value a positive work environment and contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place.
You have team production experiences, such as using version control software (we use git), branching, stand-ups, sprints, and reviews.

Practicalities

We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
No crunch. People over deadlines.
Our working language is English.

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
Pension plan and private health insurance.
Endless amounts of coffee.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. Work that powers communities.

Who We Are

Singapore Pools was established by the Singapore government on 23 May 1968 to provide safe and trusted betting to counter illegal gambling. As a not-for-profit organisation, it makes contributions to the Tote Board to fund a wide range of causes in social service, community development, sports, arts, education and health sectors.

Since 2004, over $5 billion have been channelled to the Tote Board. In addition, Singapore Pools also contributes about $2 billion annually to the Government in the form of taxes and duties. Its responsible gaming practices have been awarded the highest level of certification (Level 4) by the World Lottery Association’s Responsible Gaming Framework since 2012.

Since inception, Singapore Pools’ staff have a long-standing commitment to doing good and giving back to those in need. Staff volunteers support activities held all year round, from helping disadvantaged children, youth-at-risk, underprivileged families, and elderly, to conserving the environment.

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) drives enterprise operational resilience by architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, managing the enterprise DevOps toolchain, and ensuring centralized system observability across hybrid cloud environments. Leveraging a strong software engineering background, the SRE implements GitOps methodologies and develops custom automation applications and API-based services. By heavily utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GenAI tools, this role eliminates manual operations, drives efficiency, optimizes cloud expenditures, and ensures maximum system uptime against stringent SLAs.

What You'll Do

Software Engineering & Automation: Write code and develop automated, API-based applications (including GenAI integrations) to streamline operational reporting and eliminate recurring manual tasks.
Reliability & Operations: Implement SRE best practices for observability, availability, performance, and incident response. Define, measure, and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets in collaboration with product engineering teams. Participate in on-call rotations, execute postmortem/RCAs, and identify/fix production bottlenecks.
Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure: Support product teams in building fault-tolerant applications by enforcing infrastructure deployment via rigorous IaC code reviews.
CI/CD & Toolchain: Maintain DevOps systems and enforce GitOps workflows and integrate automated security/vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines for all application, container, and IaC deployment approvals.
Observability: Create and maintain consolidated operations dashboards by integrating telemetry from disparate monitoring tools and native AWS/Azure metrics.
FinOps: Generate actionable FinOps reporting to track and optimize hybrid cloud spending.
Resilience & Documentation: Execute disaster recovery (DR), backup, redundancy, and capacity planning strategies while maintaining high-quality runbooks and operational documentation.

Who You Are

Degree-qualified in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science or related IT Discipline, with 4 to 7 years of proven, hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, DevOps, or SRE roles.
Hold professional certifications such as ITIL, FinOps Certified Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate), Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).
Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Deep hands-on experience building scalable hybrid cloud infrastructures (AWS and Azure) and containerization. Strong understanding of modern hosting, networking design patterns, and applying the Six Pillars of operational excellence across environments.
Software Engineering: Strong background building production-level software in Python, Golang, or Java. Experience developing and deploying API-based services and serverless applications on AWS Lambda and Azure Functions.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): High proficiency in IaC and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) and container orchestration systems (e.g., Kubernetes). Proven capability in enforcing deployment pipelines through rigorous code review processes and working within Agile methodologies.
Version Control: Proficient in Git, including advanced branching strategies and GitOps paradigms.
Systems Knowledge: Deep expertise in architecting and managing centralized Observability platforms, utilizing GenAI, time-series databases, and diverse monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk, InfluxDB) to trace distributed cloud applications. Solid understanding of Database Administration and Networking architecture.
Professional & Interpersonal Skills: Ability to make sound, logical, data-based decisions on complex issues while considering risks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong interest in technological trends and disruptions impacting Cloud Engineering and SRE.

What We Offer

Health & wellness benefits

Volunteerism and community initiatives

new_jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Purpose

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.

You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Base salary range: For this role, based in Bulgaria, the base salary range is €25000-65000 per year, set using objective, gender-neutral job evaluation criteria applied to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.

Determining your actual pay: Your base salary within this range will be based on objective, gender-neutral factors — work location, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary or negotiating position, nor will it fall below the range or below what colleagues in equal work receive.

Scope: This range covers base salary only, not bonuses, benefits, or other remuneration (as applicable).

Your rights: Tungsten Automation does not ask about current or past pay, and you need not disclose it. This notice does not limit your right to negotiate or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Skills

Required Qualifications

Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
Familiarity with GitOps workflows
Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.
Understanding of platform SLOs, Error budgets, operational maturity models, and infrastructure lifecycle thinking.

As a successful Cloud Platform Engineer

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. You’re driven by delivery, not novelty, and thrive on solving operational complexity through design, automation, and simplification. You treat infrastructure the same way great product teams treat software as something to be designed, tested, versioned, and continuously improved.
